message: a concurrent binding captures `t`, which has type `Ticket` - a handle its module did not declare `shared`
label: `t` is bound outside this binding
notes: MM-PAR-6: a word struct crosses into a concurrent binding only when its module declares it `shared`, which says every operation on it is safe from several bindings at once; `__proc_spawn` names the isolated lowering and is exempt
help: use the handle only in the binding that holds it, or have its module declare `(struct Ticket word shared ...)` if every operation on it is safe from several bindings at once

message: a concurrent binding captures `v`, which has type `Vec _a` - a mutable container the parent also holds, which a binding could grow while another reads it
label: `v` is bound outside this binding
notes: MM-PAR-6: a binding runs BESIDE its parent, and `axiom_retain`/`axiom_release` are a plain load-add-store rather than an `atomicrmw` - two threads touching one block's count lose an increment and free a block a live reference still names. The rule is the language's and not the lowering's, so it does not depend on `--threads`; `__proc_spawn` names the isolated lowering and is exempt
help: pass the value in through the thunk's word argument instead of capturing it, or build a copy of it inside the binding: what the binding may share with its parent is a word. To share read-only input with several workers, use `stdlib/Par.ax`, whose forked children read their own copy
